actions.reason: K7_C0001 has an interpretable biological identity (coherent OXPHOS/mitochondrial/fatty-acid metabolic down-regulation, ER:82111b9a8db1:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:fb2d94aafe), but identity alone does not establish independent membership. Evidence directly bearing on its boundary is unsupportive: set-versus-rest alignment shows near-zero/negative silhouettes and within-versus-between distances nearly equal or reversed (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:fb2d94aafe); the closest boundary to K7_C0004 is essentially unexpressed (boundary silhouette 0.00052, within-set affinity 0.00974 vs between-set 0.00925, ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:64c8b42920; near-zero CT/RNA/WSI silhouettes, ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:64c8b42920); and the K7_C0001-K7_C0007 boundary is modality-dependent with reversed CT/RNA distance direction (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:777a140693). The union with K7_C0004 is single-cluster-dominated, which is not evidence against merge but also not sufficient to justify it, and no supported internal subdivision exists. With independent retention not positively justified after decision-relevant boundary evidence is exhausted, drop is appropriate.

K7_C0002 has an interpretable biological identity (coordinated immune/inflammatory down-regulation with OXPHOS up, ER:82111b9a8db1:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:7ab5139254) and positive evidence that its current membership is represented: silhouettes are positive in all four modalities and within-set distances are smaller than between-set in every modality (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:7ab5139254). Its closest boundary, to K7_C0003, is expressed with positive silhouettes in all four modalities and consistently smaller within-set distances (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:b893638d10), and the two sets carry opposite-direction immune programs (K7_C0002 immune-down vs K7_C0003 immune-up), weighing against one-unit representation. Independent membership is positively supported.
